purpose: Cross-walker known-answer test for the #141748 residual. Three walkers derive the manifest path string from DIFFERENT native inputs — SIGNER (build-file -> served-URL map), SW (request.url -> pathname), WATCHTOWER (fetch-URL -> pathname) — and MUST produce the BYTE-IDENTICAL string for the same asset, or Apollo's bundle_hash silently disagrees (WARN-storms / verify gap). Co-witnessed by Apollo (signer) + Flint (independent).
rule: path = new URL(requestUrl).pathname WHEN URL.origin === origin, else null. NO decodeURIComponent. Query/fragment are dropped by URL.pathname. Dot-segments (./ , ../) ARE resolved by URL — the signer must NEVER emit them (a clean fs walk does not). NO trailing-slash normalization. NO double-slash collapse. Case-sensitive. %-encoding AS-SERVED; NFC and NFD of the same visual path are DISTINCT percent-encodings — the signer must read the as-served filename and never re-normalize.

coverage.static: exact-path SRI — this vector's expectedPath IS the manifest key and the request-time lookup key
coverage.shell: content-hash membership — the served navigation HTML's SHA256 must be in the shell-hash-set; expectedPath is shown only as the signer's shell KEY (route template), NOT used for request-time lookup (a dynamic-param route serves one byte-stable shell across infinite paths, e.g. /u/alice == /u/bob)

stringAgreement: The 3-way byte-identical path-STRING agreement is LOAD-BEARING only for class:static entries — the SW does exact-path KEY lookup, so request.url->pathname MUST byte-match the signer's emitted path or the lookup misses -> WARN. class:shell entries are verified by content-hash SET membership: the served concrete path (/u/alice) is NEVER matched against a manifest key, so a shell's expectedPath is the signer's canonical template KEY (documentary only); the load-bearing shell property is that all 3 walkers agree on the shell-HASH-SET, co-witnessed separately. (Apollo #142024.)

cases.note: VERIFIED BY CONTENT-MEMBERSHIP, not by this path. /u/alice and /u/bob are byte-identical shells. Signer KEY = /u/[name].
